author: reek
body: The identity pose scales by one. It scaled by a thousand, because Vec3 was fixed-point when this was written and a thousand meant unity there; bp-to-mat4 hands the scale straight to mat4-scale, where 1.0 is identity. So the identity BonePose was a thousandfold magnification, and it type-checked perfectly. The same bug lived in Scene3D's t3-identity.

author: reek
body: The blend parameter stays an integer in thousandths at the API, because that is what every caller counts in, and crosses to Real once. Vec3 and Quat are Real: quat-slerp already declares a Real t, and weighting a Real component by an integer thousandth was the shape of the rot here.

author: reek
body: A Vertex holds integer world coordinates and Vec3 is Real, so a vertex crosses into the skinning maths and back out again. The bone weights stay integer thousandths, which is what a SkinWeight stores.
